mapper.sql: t.id AS ticket_id, t.order_item_id, oi.order_id, e.id AS event_id, es.id AS session_id, oi.sku_id, t.status, t.used_at, t.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_item_id, owner_user_id, checkin_code_hash, status, used_at, created_at FROM tickets WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, order_item_id, owner_user_id, checkin_code_hash, status, used_at, created_at FROM tickets WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} LIMIT 1

SELECT oi.id AS order_item_id, o.id AS order_id, o.user_id AS owner_user_id, e.id AS event_id, e.organizer_id AS organizer_id, es.id AS session_id, oi.sku_id, oi.quantity, o.status AS order_status, es.starts_at, es.ends_at FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ticket_skus sku ON sku.id = oi.sku_id JOIN event_sessions es ON es.id = sku.session_id JOIN events e ON e.id = es.event_id WHERE oi.id = #{orderItemId}

SELECT FROM tickets t JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = t.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ticket_skus sku ON sku.id = oi.sku_id JOIN event_sessions es ON es.id = sku.session_id JOIN events e ON e.id = es.event_id WHERE t.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.user_id = t.owner_user_id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE checkin_code_hash = #{codeHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM tickets t JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = t.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN ticket_skus sku ON sku.id = oi.sku_id JOIN event_sessions es ON es.id = sku.session_id JOIN events e ON e.id = es.event_id WHERE t.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.user_id = t.owner_user_id ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = t.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE t.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.user_id = t.owner_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tickets (order_item_id, owner_user_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{ownerUserId}, 'UNUSED', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO checkin_records (ticket_id, operator_user_id, result, created_at) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{operatorUserId}, 'SUCCESS', #{createdAt})
